# Boca Remodeling Group

> Remodeling company in Boca Raton, Florida. They draw a room before they build it: a first sketch, then the room in 3D, then their crews build it ("high-quality home and back yard 3D design for many years", their words). The list painted on their trucks: kitchens, bathrooms, windows, roofs, pools. They also take on plumbing, electrical and carpentry, back yards and decks, "everything from repairs to major renovations". "Over 30 years experience in construction" (their words). Florida license CGC1539814, Certified General Contractor, current and active through August 31, 2028 (Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation), doing business as Boca Remodeling Group. Office at 7284 West Palmetto Park Road, Suite 101, Boca Raton, FL 33433, Monday to Friday, 9 am to 5 pm; "Our customers are welcome to visit us." Phone 561-247-2727; email bocarcg@gmail.com. Free quotes.

## Drawn first, then built

- [A primary bathroom](https://bocaremodelinggroup.com/): sketched by hand in colored pencil, drawn in 3D two weeks later, then built. The finished room keeps what the sketch put down: two sinks and a makeup counter, a freestanding tub under the window, a glass shower with a bench and a pebble floor.
- [A kitchen with two quartzite islands](https://bocaremodelinggroup.com/#drawn): the plan and the 3D drawn on their office screen the same afternoon; two months later, an island polished on site; two weeks after that, finished, with black glass cabinets added along the top.
- [A bathroom with the tub on a step](https://bocaremodelinggroup.com/#drawn): a 3D plan with its measurements, then the room built: a gray stone shower with a wood slat floor, the tub on its step, a vanity with a makeup counter.

## What they do

- [Kitchens, bathrooms, windows, roofs, pools](https://bocaremodelinggroup.com/#trades): the list on their truck doors, with photos of their kitchens, baths, roofs and pools. Also plumbing, electrical, carpentry, back yards and decks, from repairs to major renovations.

## Their work, in their own photos

- [More of their work](https://bocaremodelinggroup.com/#work): the sketched bathroom, finished; a bath in blue-gray stone with a freestanding tub and a brass floor faucet; new tile roofs, with their crews, their trucks and a crane lifting the tiles; a pool under its screen cage by a golf course; two baths with lit mirrors and a glass shower; a living room with a grand piano; a pool deck; the two-island kitchen going in.
- Every photo on the site is of their own projects in Florida.
